source: CProgressDlg::OnCancel reads ConfirmKillProcess, asks source Yes/No text if enabled, kills process tree only after Yes, writes log and closes. Native waits for actual owned process unwind before retirement.
implemented: Optional owned native Yes/No sheet using existing Settings preference and exact upstream prompt.
No leaves active reset running; Yes and direct cancellation close progress/options after process cleanup, retaining model output and one repository-refresh callback.
Pending confirmation gates duplicate Cancel, Close, post-actions and Quit, even after command completion.
Completion waits for reply; completed successful reset is not relabeled cancelled. Accepted completed response closes, declined completed response applies existing auto-close preference.
Per-request/token identities fence duplicate callbacks, old response during new prompt and late replies after invalidation.
Forced owner/progress close cancels operation, invalidates reply and tears down owned alert.
NSAlert reply is deferred one main-queue turn so automatic close occurs after sheet detachment.

scenarios: Actual owned Yes/No buttons, exact prompt text and duplicate/close/Quit gates.
Decline preserves running helper and permits successful completion.
Accept cancels/reaps and retires actual progress/owner.
Success while question pending delays auto-close; both Yes/No retain success and complete close.
Forced close tears down real alert and rejects result callbacks.
Injected reply declines, then duplicate accepted reply ignored; old reply cannot resolve new prompt; all replies after forced close ignored.
Existing no-confirm cancellation now retires actual progress after unwind; prior real reset/retry/stream/keyboard checks retained.
